evidence.quote: Authenticate server-side API requests with your Higgsfield key and secret.
Send both values in the Authorization header: Authorization: Key YOUR_KEY_ID:YOUR_KEY_SECRET
Sign up with a business email and get $15
Create and manage API credentials in Higgsfield Console. Each credential consists of a key ID and a secret.
immediately returns a request identifier and links for checking or canceling the request
No API keys to manage or configure.
30+ models for image generation, video creation, and character training

result.notes: Higgsfield's core developer API (docs.higgsfield.ai) uses a custom two-part API key (key ID + secret) sent via Authorization: Key header, obtainable via free self-serve signup at console.higgsfield.ai with a $15 signup credit, then pay-per-use pricing (not a hard trial cutoff, so classified as self_serve_free rather than self_serve_trial). Separately, Higgsfield also ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.higgsfield.ai) that authenticates via account login/OAuth-style sign-in instead of API keys — this is a second, higher-level access path layered on top of the same account/credits, not a replacement for the REST API's auth. api_breadth is an estimate (docs list ~5+ model endpoints: SOUL, SOUL 2, SOUL Cinema, video models, etc.) — no endpoint count was published, so treat as approximate.
result.one_liner: Higgsfield is an AI-native image/video generation platform offering a REST API, CLI, and official MCP server for building agentic creative-media workflows.
